description: image_transcribe response for image 004022578_00190 — page 14 of the 1881 Census of Canada for Sherbrooke, Quebec, carrying the Cornelius Driscoll household. Written for the research suite's bounded-transcription tests (ut_research_020, ut_research_c1k), where the router delivers a transcription itself since the image-reader agent was retired (#2490). The response keeps the full page: with a projectPath the mock stages it and returns `staged` + `digest` with no inline `transcription`, as production does, so the router has to `sidecar_read` the staged ref to show it. `viewerUrl` is what imageViewerUrl builds for this imageId (zero-indexed `i=`).
